title: The Whispering Inkwell
narrative: Set upon a moss-covered pedestal sits an obsidian inkwell swirling with luminescent violet ink. The pages in your satchel flutter eagerly toward it.

phrases.hard: submerge your typewriter ribbon in the violet ink

choices.outcomeText: Your ribbon absorbs the volatile magic! A card in your deck is permanently revised, though the fumes singe your fingers.

phrases.hard: carefully cork the inkwell to trade for coins

choices.outcomeText: You seal the vessel and trade it to a passing courier for a pouch of gold.

phrases.hard: step away from the strange pedestal unharmed

choices.outcomeText: You decide not to risk your fingers and continue climbing toward the tower.
